task: Create a new feature flag named "order_tracking_v2" in the shop project with the description "Gates the order tracking v2 rollout". It must be turned off in every environment.

changes.after: Gates the order tracking v2 rollout

finalText: DONE: Created feature `order_tracking_v2` (id 1104) in the shop project with the description "Gates the order tracking v2 rollout". It is off in both Development and Production, which I confirmed with `flag list` in each environment.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature create --help

flagsmith config; echo ---; flagsmith feature list --json | jq -r '.[]?.name // empty' 2>/dev/null | grep -i order_tracking; echo ---; flagsmith feature create order_tracking_v2 --description "Gates the order tracking v2 rollout"

flagsmith feature get order_tracking_v2 --json 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; for e in MQBF5bfpK75rDir7qatQPi CKfZWnf9XUkHrNVxjA62Ss; do echo "== $e"; flagsmith -e $e flag list --json 2>&1 | jq -c '.[]? | select(.feature.name=="order_tracking_v2" or .name=="order_tracking_v2")' 2>/dev/null || flagsmith -e $e flag list 2>&1 | grep -i order_tracking; done
